questions.title: WHERE Clause Role
questions.description: What does the WHERE clause do in a SELECT statement?
questions.Option3: Removes duplicate columns from the result

questions.title: Not Equal Operator
questions.description: Which operator means not equal in SQLite?

questions.title: AND Requires Both
questions.description: WHERE electric = 1 AND rides_today > 10 — which bikes are returned?
questions.Option1: Bikes matching at least one condition
questions.Option4: All bikes that have any rides

questions.title: OR Broadens The Net
questions.description: station = 'Riverside' OR station = 'Harbor' — which rows are returned?
questions.Option3: Rows matching at least one condition

questions.title: IN Is A Shorthand
questions.description: station IN ('Riverside', 'Harbor') is equivalent to which condition?

questions.title: BETWEEN Includes Endpoints
questions.description: hourly_rate BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.0 — are bikes priced exactly 3.0 or 5.0 included?
questions.Option3: Only the lower endpoint is included
questions.Option4: Only the upper endpoint is included

questions.title: Percent Wildcard Meaning
questions.description: In a LIKE pattern, what does % match?

questions.title: Underscore Wildcard Meaning
questions.description: In a LIKE pattern, what does _ match?

questions.title: Finding Missing Values
questions.description: Which condition correctly finds bikes whose maintenance_due has no value?
questions.subtopic: IS NULL and IS NOT NULL

questions.title: Comparing Against NULL
questions.description: For a row where rides_today is NULL, what does the condition rides_today = 0 evaluate to?
questions.subtopic: IS NULL and IS NOT NULL
questions.Option3: NULL — unknown, so the row is filtered out

questions.title: AND Binds Tighter Than OR
questions.description: How does SQLite parenthesize the WHERE condition in this snippet?
questions.Option3: SQLite rejects it — parentheses are mandatory
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, model FROM bikes
WHERE electric = 0 OR electric = 1 AND rides_today > 20;

questions.title: IN Meets NULL
questions.description: The snippet filters the bikes table. Which rows come back?
questions.Option3: No rows — the NULL poisons the whole list
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, model FROM bikes
WHERE station IN ('Riverside', NULL);

questions.title: LIKE Is Case-Blind For ASCII
questions.description: What does the snippet return?
questions.Option1: Only rows where model contains lowercase glide
questions.Option2: Rows containing glide case-insensitively (ASCII letters), so 'City Glide' matches
questions.Option3: Nothing — LIKE is case-sensitive in SQLite
questions.Option4: Only models that start with glide
questions.codesnippet: SELECT id, model FROM bikes WHERE model LIKE '%glide%';

questions.title: BETWEEN On Text Dates
questions.description: Why does the snippet's date filter work correctly?
questions.Option1: SQLite silently converts the text to real date values
questions.Option2: BETWEEN casts both sides to numbers before comparing
questions.Option3: ISO-8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD) compare correctly as plain text
questions.Option4: It does not work — dates always need the date() function
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, model FROM bikes
WHERE maintenance_due BETWEEN '2024-06-01' AND '2024-06-30';

questions.title: De Morgan Reading
questions.description: NOT (a AND b) is logically equivalent to which condition?

questions.title: Three Valued AND
questions.description: In SQL's three-valued logic, FALSE AND NULL evaluates to what?
questions.subtopic: IS NULL and IS NOT NULL
questions.Option4: It depends on the column collation

questions.title: ALL Translates To Maximum
questions.description: In standard SQL, x > ALL (list of rates) holds only when x beats every item. Comparing x against which single value is equivalent?
questions.Option1: The minimum value in the list
questions.Option3: The number of items in the list
questions.Option4: The maximum value in the list

questions.title: ANY Translates To Minimum
questions.description: In standard SQL, x > ANY (list) holds when x beats at least one item. Which statement restates it?
questions.Option1: x is greater than at least one value in the list
questions.Option2: x is greater than every value in the list
questions.Option3: x equals the maximum of the list
questions.Option4: x is below the minimum of the list

questions.title: NULL Poisons NOT IN
questions.description: The bikes table has some rows and the snippet runs fine. What comes back?
questions.Option1: No rows — the comparison is never TRUE when the list contains NULL
questions.Option4: Only bikes with a NULL station
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, model FROM bikes
WHERE station NOT IN ('Riverside', NULL);

questions.title: NOT Flips The Whole Group
questions.description: NOT (electric = 1 OR rides_today > 20) is equivalent to which simpler condition?
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT id, model FROM bikes
WHERE NOT (electric = 1 OR rides_today > 20);
